277:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What's wrong, $$ランド$$? You're oddly serious for once...」

277:t_10:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「Oops...! Guess the real me slipped out.」

277:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Perish the thought! You'd make the name $$ザ・ヒート$$ weep.」

277:t_10:7.en:
$$ランド$$
「That's the thing, though... That lady who showed up at the end... She called me something-something $$ザ・ヒート$$ or other...」

277:t_10:8.en:
$$ランド$$
「I don't know any beauties like her, though...」

277:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A mysterious space, a mysterious beauty... A mystery is a mystery, after all. Racking our brains over it here won't get us beyond guesswork.」

277:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「More to the point, what makes me happy is that we managed to wipe out that army of terror.」

277:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I... got so carried away that I ended up producing a $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 100 Z all by myself. Of course, I added it to the unit's stock.」

277:t_10:13.en:
$$ランド$$
「I've got to hand it to you, your obsession with $$Ｚチップ$$s.」

277:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Naturally! That's what a dimensional merchant is all about!」

277:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Yes... And that is precisely our last hope.)

277:t_10:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As I thought, the $$血塗られた眼$$ is still bothering you.」

277:t_10:23.en:
$n
「About that, it's as I told $$アルト$$ and the others. There's nothing I can make out at this point...」

277:t_10:24.en:
$n
「So I'll just deal with what's in front of me, one thing at a time.」

277:t_10:26.en:
$n
「I can manage my own problems myself. The problem is...」

277:t_10:29.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Who knows... She's not the troublesome student she used to be, after all...」

277:t_10:30.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As a man, why not fill the gap in her heart for her...!」

277:t_10:31.en:
$n
「I was a fool to ask you.」

277:t_10:33.en:
$n
「If I stay here, I'll end up stuck minding the $$Ｄトレーダー$$ shop.」

277:t_10:38.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Finding hope in any despair... How touching they are, the $$いがみ合う双子$$.」

277:t_10:39.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It depends on the person. $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$ drew out the power of his $$スフィア$$ through anger and resignation, after all.」

277:t_10:40.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I don't care about a dead man. What matters is what comes next.」

277:t_10:42.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Everything has started moving... toward the true collapse that comes once every 120 million years...」

277:t_10:43.en:
$$スズネ$$
「The moment we return to Earth is the beginning of the end, then...」

277:t_10:45.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Until then, keep putting your heart into your business.」

277:t_10:46.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course! Then let's give it our all again today... business, business!」

278:t_000:2.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「Current position confirmed. We're near Jupiter in the world we came from.」

278:t_000:4.en:
$$渓$$
「W-we jumped from the center of the galaxy to the Solar System in an instant...」

278:t_000:5.en:
$$凱$$
「Ha, hahaha! We did it! We did it!!」

278:t_000:6.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Indeed. Never mind the process, the result is something to be glad about.」

278:t_000:7.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「Stay alert. A fleet is approaching us.」

278:t_001:0.en:
$$渓$$
「The $$クォーター$$ and the $$ラー・カイラム$$! The $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ and the $$プトレマイオス$$ are there too!」

278:t_001:1.en:
$$田中司令$$
「This is a surprise. To think we'd come face to face with everyone we got separated from in subspace in a place like this...」

278:t_001:2.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「So they had returned to the Solar System too...」

278:t_001:3.en:
$$凱$$
「Hold on a minute! Isn't this a little too good to be true!」

278:t_001:4.en:
$$渓$$
「Y-yeah...! Even I can't just shrug this off with 'Thank goodness, thank goodness!'」

278:t_001:6.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Well, there's no use flustering around here, so let's join up with everyone and exchange information.」

278:t_001:7.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
(The galactic center... then the transfer to a mysterious universe... then the return to the Solar System and the rendezvous with allies... It's all far too convenient...)

278:t_001:8.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
(Is this... the work of someone's will...?)
